other_conditions: Must be unmarried at the time of application and the marriage must be her first marriage
Prospective groom must be at least 21 years old
Family may have one or two daughters eligible for the scheme
The girl must have completed at least 10th standard or equivalent education
The applicant must have an active bank account where she is the sole account holder, with IFSC and MICR codes supporting NEFT transactions
Application must be submitted at least 30 days before the marriage date and no later than one year after the marriage date
The applicant must be a resident of West Bengal (born in West Bengal, or resident for the last 5 years, or parents are permanent residents)
benefits_summary: Provides a one‑time financial assistance of Rs. 25,000 to eligible families for the marriage of their daughters.
documents_required: Self‑declaration of family income certified by a competent authority
Self‑declaration of residence certified by a competent authority
Bank book page showing account holder name, account number, bank address, IFSC code
Marriage Invitation Card or Notice for Registration of Marriage
Proof of prospective groom’s age (e.g., Birth Certificate, Voter ID card, PAN Card, Madhyamik Admit card, AADHAR card, Primary School Leaving Certificate)
Coloured passport‑size photographs of the applicant and the prospective groom
